title: Liminal Spaces
html:
I’ve found myself in a precarious position.

Recently, I left my job, I left my relationship, and I’ll be leaving graduate school in a few months.

I’m floating in liminal space, tethered to nothing but my own imagination—swarming with fragments of lives I might one day live.

The dizziness of possibility is setting in.

I feel sick.

Nauseous, I keep moving forward.

My balance? Questionable.

My will? Strong.

I need to go for a long walk.

I’ll let you know what I figure out.
